root_cause.text: The `__scmi_event_handler_get_ops` function returns `NULL` on failure instead of an `ERR_PTR`, violating the expectations of its callers and leading to a NULL pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff modifies `__scmi_event_handler_get_ops` in `drivers/firmware/arm_scmi/notify.c` to return `hndl ?: ERR_PTR(-ENODEV);` instead of `hndl`, and the commit message states that "call chains leading to the helper __scmi_event_handler_get_ops expect an ERR_PTR to be returned on failure... while the current helper can still return a NULL".
